panel_scope: Small point-in-time normalization sample; not universe warm-up or strategy research evidence.

records.timestamp_interpretation: Binance kline open_time and inclusive close_time in epoch milliseconds UTC.
records.availability_assumption: Available at close_time + 1 millisecond. The archive does not contain original publication or ingestion latency.
records.original_units: OHLC in USDT per BTC; base volume in BTC; quote volume in USDT.
records.coverage_note: One full calendar day of 1h klines only; 24 records and no claim of a complete warm-up window.

records.timestamp_interpretation: Binance aggregate transact_time in epoch milliseconds UTC; exchange aggregate trade IDs retained.
records.availability_assumption: Exchange transact_time is used as an event-time availability proxy. The archive has no stream arrival or backfill publication timestamps.
records.original_units: Price in USDT per APE; quantity in APE; buyer-maker boolean retained; IDs are aggregate-trade IDs.
records.coverage_note: Only the first 100 contiguous aggregate trades of the source day are retained. This is a bounded trade-derived smoke window, not a full-day CVD or liquidity sample.

limitations: No ETH archive was present in the inspected source fixture set; BTC is the available context contract.
This bounded panel does not satisfy 720 closed 1h or 200 closed 4h eligibility warm-up and does not contain spread, depth, OI, funding, or verified event history.
Historical availability is represented by the stated exchange-time assumptions; the original archive publication latency was not available.
